businesses.business: government technology and infrastructure engineering services

offering_description.value: Provides engineering, technology, design, program and construction management services for U.S. government defense, intelligence and cyber customers and for critical infrastructure such as transportation, water and urban development. Delivers through professional staff under contracts, mostly with government agencies.

primary_services.value: engineering and design; program and construction management; cybersecurity and intelligence support; systems integration; space and missile defense technical support

customer_segment.value: B2G: U.S. Department of Defense, intelligence agencies, Homeland Security, federal civil agencies, state and local transportation authorities, foreign governments; B2B: private infrastructure developers, utilities and commercial clients

end_markets.value: defense; intelligence and cybersecurity; transportation infrastructure; water and environmental; urban development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: government contracts: cost-plus, fixed-price and time-and-materials engineering and program management; service fees: technical and professional services billed to agencies and infrastructure owners

value_chain_position.value: service provider: engineering, technology and management services delivered by professional staff to government and infrastructure owners

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Middle East, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: federal solutions (defense, intelligence, cyber) and critical infrastructure engineering and management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bids and proposals to government agencies and infrastructure owners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: government contracting rules (FAR, security clearances, export controls) and engineering licensing standards
